title: EE30014: Utilisation Of Electric Power
text:
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Tariff: one part, two part; Availability based tariff: rate, objective,
implementation; Perspective of industrial energy conservation; Illumination:
sources of light, electronic control of light, illumination of interiors,
exteriors, special areas(sports complex, airport etc.), laws of illumination,
design of illumination systems by point-to-point method, average method;
Electric drives: review of motor and load characteristics, four quadrant
drives, mechanical coupling, referred inertia and torque, steady state
stability, selection of motor rating; Industrial drive application examples:
pump drives, rolling mill drives, types(VSI, CSI and cycloconverter based),
basic principle of operation, torque speed characteristics, closed loop
control; Traction drives: basic traction requirements, specifications,
different configurations and components of electric traction drives, rating
calculations, economic aspects; Electric vehicle drives: pure and hybrid
electric vehicles, series and parallel hybrid configurations, range and power,
battery storage calculations, battery, motor and drive selections, IC engine
power calculations, power splitting devices, control techniques; Industrial
heating: different methods of heating-comparison; Application areas: resistive,
induction, microwave(dielectric), infrared, representative details of each
type.
